content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Virginia Beach

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review PMI's specific thresholds based on your degree level and years of hands-on project leadership. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify whether your background qualifies.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our Virginia Beach cohorts are designed for working professionals, delivering all required formal education in an accelerated format without compromising depth or rigor.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Apply directly to PMI with your education and experience documentation. Pay PMI's exam fee at the time of application. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the submission process to ensure accuracy and timely approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor feedback—to build confidence. Schedule your exam once PMI approves your application, then sit for the assessment at an authorized testing center.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers continuing education options to help you meet PMI's maintenance requirements and stay current.
